key_facts: Central entities only, grounded descriptions, short verb phrases (METHODOLOGY.md)
Produces provisional entities for unmatched names (METHODOLOGY.md)
summary: Extraction is the first judgment stage of the methodology: per document chunk, the agent extracts only central entities with one-sentence descriptions grounded in that document, plus short-verb-phrase relations that connect two extracted entities. Precision beats recall because a wrong entity spawns wrong edges. Names are resolved against the canonical set by exact match; unmatched names become provisional entities. The evaluation loop tunes the extraction prompt.
